Detailed Description

Style class for standard m buttons. 

        MButtonStyle {
            font: arial 12;

            icon-id: "my-icon";
            toggled-icon-id: "my-toggled-icon"
            icon-size: 32 32;
            icon-align: left;

            text-color: white;

            vertical-text-align: vcenter;
            horizontal-text-align: hcenter;

            text-margin-left: 5;
            text-margin-top: 0;
            text-margin-right: 5;
            text-margin-bottom: 0;
        }
